title: Handle orders from shops
intro: When a shop sells your product, the order comes to you. Here's how to handle it, from new order to pickup.

steps.caption: New orders on Home
steps.vo: New orders show on your Home screen, under Needs you. Tap them to see what shops have ordered.

steps.caption: Accept before the timer
steps.vo: On Orders, the New tab shows each order, and how long you have to accept it.

steps.caption: Accept the order
steps.vo: Open an order to see the product, the shop, and where it's going. Tap Accept order, so the shop knows you have it. If you don't have it, tap I don't have it.

steps.caption: Pack it for pickup
steps.vo: Pack it in its own packaging, with the shop's delivery label. Don't add flyers or your number. Then tap It's packed, ready for pickup. A rider collects it from you, and you don't pay for delivery.

steps.caption: Price requests
steps.vo: Shops can also ask for your price on a large order. You'll find these under Price requests.

steps.caption: Send your price
steps.vo: Type your price for each one, pick when it can be ready, and tap Send my price. If the shop says yes, the order shows up under New.

outro: Next up: how you get paid.
